name: molio
description: Molio - AI-powered knowledge management and document publishing platform

scripts.dev: pnpm build:contracts && concurrently "pnpm --filter @molio/daemon dev" "pnpm --filter @molio/web dev" --names daemon,web --prefix-colors auto
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @molio/cloud test && pnpm --filter @molio/daemon test && pnpm --filter @molio/cli test && pnpm --filter dsh-plugin-molio test && pnpm test:desktop && pnpm --filter @molio/web test && node --test "apps/landing-page/test/*.test.mjs"
